name: Demo — Operation Dream Job
description: Demo scenario inspired by publicly documented Operation Dream Job activity. It expands selected behaviors across logical layers to create a rich ATT&CK visualization and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: Adversary Infrastructure
layers.description: Research recruiting targets and prepare convincing personas, domains, hosted content, servers, and custom malware.

layers.name: External Engagement
layers.description: Approach targets with job-themed messages and deliver malicious files, links, or content through trusted online services.

layers.name: User Endpoint
layers.description: Execute staged payloads, establish user-level persistence, profile the host, and communicate over common web protocols.

layers.name: Enterprise Network
layers.description: Enumerate domain resources, locate valuable files, archive collections, and return data over the established command channel.
